notes.title: 1 month before Fall of Bali release: Looking back Fall of Bali from 2015 to 2024
notes.notes:
Dear everyone..

1 month from now, Fall of Bali will release. This will be biggest milestone for Sengkala Dev as development of Fall of Bali has taken very long time to finish it. Fall of Bali project started in June 2022 with Unity as main engine, but actually Fall of Bali more longer than it since Fall of Bali is the remake version of Pedalahusa Fall of Bali. Pedalahusa Fall of Bali was first game of Sengkala Dev and developed with Gamemaker Studio 1.4 since 6 November 2015. So development of Fall of Bali not just from 2022, but from 2015. Pedalahusa Fall of Bali stop the development in January 2017. 

You can see the legacy page Pedalahusa Fall of Bali https://sengkala.itch.io/pedalahusa-fall-of-bali

Story of Pedalahusa Fall of Bali mentioned in our story in Gamedeveloper (before Gamasutra) in April 2020. https://www.gamedeveloper.com/production/making-indonesian-historical-strategy-games-story-of-sengkala-dev

Also in January 2022, the story of Pedalahusa Fall of Bali mentioned https://sengkaladev.com/2023/01/02/sengkala-dev-in-2022-long-path-in-making-indonesia-historical-games-for-almost-7-years/

Now let’s compare the comparision between Pedalahusa Fall of Bali to current Fall of Bali version!
